 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. The Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 835 of 2021 dated 10.08.2021 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 341, 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner happens to be the husband of O.P. No.2(Complainant) and the said O.P. No.2 is completely unwilling to lead a conjugal relationship with this petitioner and earlier the petitioner filed Habeas Corpus writ petition No. 700 of 2022 before the Hon'ble Allahabad High Court in which the Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.72569 of 2023(2) dt.09-11-2023 O.P. No.2 was produced and on account of her unwillingness to reunite with this petitioner the prayer of the petitioner was dismissed and the order passed in the said writ petition has been filed as Annexure-2 which completely goes to show that it is the wife of the petitioner who is completely not interested in residing in the company of the petitioner and she has also filed a maintenance case against this petitioner which is pending before the concerned court.
Further submission is that the petitioner is in deep apprehension of his arrest.

5. In the meantime, no coercive action shall be taken against this petitioner till further order.

6. List this case after receipt of service report of notice upon O.P. No. 2 after five weeks.
